{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Nakrikal Singularity:'' This black hole tugs on the fabric of hyperspace, sometimes addling the navicomputers of starships passing down the Sanrafsix Corridor. We are giving this part of the sector a wide berth; our mission will be perilous enough as it is.|A cartographical survey and field report by Vannar Treece|<ref name="Gazetter" />}}
The '''Nakrikal Singularity''' was a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] that lay in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. It affected the [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computers]] of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] traveling along the nearby [[Sanrafsix Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Arkadia Calimondra]] attempted to dispose of the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']] by providing the vessel's [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]], [[Brigadier]] [[Jarrow Rusher]], with [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] coordinates that would unknowingly lead his ship into the Nakrikal Singularity.

==Description==
The Nakrikal Singularity was a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]]<ref name="Gazetter" /> located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TrailingSectors" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It lay to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] west of the [[Sanrafsix Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="Gazetter" />

According to a [[Astrography|cartographical]] survey and field report compiled by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]]<ref name="Gazetter" /> by [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-knight-errant-gazetter|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The Knight Errant Gazetteer|int=The Knight Errant Gazetteer}} is presented as an [[in-universe]] [[Astrography|cartographical]] survey and field report compiled shortly before the [[Raid on Oranessan|commencement]] of [[Operation Influx]], which {{SWArchive|url=vault/books/knighterrant_influx/index.html|text=''Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx''|int=Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx}} dates to [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].</ref> the Nakrikal Singularity tugged on the fabric of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The report also stated that the black hole occasionally interfered with [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computers]] aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] traveling along the Sanrafsix Corridor.<ref name="Gazetter" />

==History==
{{Quote|You're really going to let the mercenaries leave?''"<br />"''They can leave. They just won't live. Those hyperspace coordinates I gave the brigadier will drop them into the Nakrikal Singularity.|Narsk Ka'hane and Arkadia Calimondra|<ref name="KnightErrant">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Arkadia_Calimondra_portrait.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Arkadia Calimondra attempted to dispose of the mercenary transport ''Diligence'' in the Nakrikal Singularity.]]
While preparing to mount [[Operation Influx]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-conducted raid in the Grumani [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="Gazetter" /> in 1032 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Vannar Treece planned for the Jedi team to avoid the part of the sector containing the Nakrikal Singularity due to the danger posed by the black hole.<ref name="Gazetter" />

That same year,<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']] to [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].</ref> after the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']], [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[Brigadier]] [[Jarrow Rusher]], arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Syned]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Arkadia Calimondra]], the latter provided Rusher with hyperspace coordinates. Calimondra claimed that the [[Astrogation/Legends|navigational]] data would lead the mercenaries' ship out of her realm, the [[Arkadianate]].<ref name="KnightErrant" />

However, since the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] wanted to dispose of the mercenaries, the coordinates would actually cause the ''Diligence'' to drop into the Nakrikal Singularity, leading to the [[Death/Legends|death]] of everyone aboard the ship. The ''Diligence'' eventually followed another set of hyperspace coordinates instead, ones given to Rusher by the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Narsk Ka'hane]] that led to [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="KnightErrant" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nakrikal Singularity was first mentioned in [[The Knight Errant Gazetteer|''Essential Atlas'' Extra: The ''Knight Errant'' Gazetteer]], a [[2010]] [[StarWars.com]] article co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]], [[Jason Fry]], and [[John Jackson Miller]] that served as a supplement to<ref name="GazetteerOriginal">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/knighterrant_atlas/index.html|text=''Essential Atlas'' Extra: The ''Knight Errant'' Gazetteer|int=The Knight Errant Gazetteer}}</ref> the [[2009]] reference book<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="Gazetter" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the ''Atlas'' placed the black hole in grid square N-17.<ref name="EAOC" />
